logline: A tiny town under glass. A giant hand shows you, one rule at a time, how the systems around you are built to steer you: casinos, scams, apps, stores, cults.

format.topic_structure: One topic = 5-8 rules. Day 1 of a topic: hook + 'they just need N rules' + rule 1. Each next day: one rule, demonstrated in the town. Final day of a topic: recap all rules in a fast montage + ask the comments to pick the next topic.
format.demonstration: Every rule must be SHOWN: the hand changes something in the town (removes the clock, bricks the windows, swaps money for chips, adds a near-miss light...). Add new town props in render/players/diorama.js when a rule needs one.
format.narration_style: Calm, confident, slightly ominous. Short declarative sentences. 'Nobody forces you to stay. They just need seven rules.' One keyword per sentence in *asterisks* (yellow highlight).
format.accuracy: Every rule must be a real, well-documented technique. No made-up statistics. Don't name real companies; describe the industry.

voices._note: Calm explainer: am_echo blended with am_fenrir. Never add echo/reverb to voices.

voting_rules.how: On the last day of a topic, the most-liked comment naming a system/industry picks the next topic. During a topic, comments can request 'show it with X' and the best one can be used as a demonstration.

rules: Take away time (no clocks, no windows)
Make you walk past everything (maze layouts)
Near misses feel like almost winning
Make leaving feel like losing (comps, status tiers)

topic_backlog.topic: How supermarkets make you spend more

safety_rules: Educational and protective framing: the point is to help viewers recognize manipulation.
No partisan politics, no real people, no real company names, no medical/financial advice.

scene_types.town: {clock: bool, windows: open|bricked, casino: bool}: persistent changes go in episode 'town', per-scene in scene 'town'
scene_types.hand: {pose: hover|point|pinch, from:[x,y], to:[x,y], held: clock|brick|null, tap: bool, move: seconds}; fingertip roughly at (x, y+150)
scene_types.plaque: text on the gold plaque (e.g. '7 RULES', 'RULE 1')

brand: assets/brand/modeltown/ (avatar.png, banner.png); names, handles and bios in assets/brand/BRAND_KIT.md
